# Nishan Rajak Portfolio - Complete LLM Knowledge Base
Version: 1.0.0
Website: https://nishudevportfolio.vercel.app
Source: https://github.com/nishur31

## Bio
Nishan Rajak (Nishu) is a full-stack engineer and distributed systems builder with deep expertise in TypeScript, Next.js, Fastify/Bun, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redis, Docker, and AI/LLM integrations.

## Architecture
- Frontend: Next.js 14 App Router, React 18, Redux Toolkit, TailwindCSS, KaTeX, Framer Motion
- Backend: Bun, Fastify 4, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, Upstash Redis, WebAuthn Passkeys
- Testimonials Collection System:
  - Verification challenge workflow preventing spam
  - Cryptographically signed single-use invitation tokens
  - Strict human moderation approval gate before publishing
  - Allowlisted public DTO ensuring privacy (no email or audit metadata exposure)

## Public Testimonial Submission
Visitors and collaborators can submit testimonials directly at:
https://nishudevportfolio.vercel.app/testimonials/submit
All submissions enter PENDING status and are moderated by Nishan before appearing on the portfolio.
